answer: Practically, the chain should pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because whisper only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, jade is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
